ocr.selection_policy: unique strong identifier, best identifier score, mean retained-box confidence, original order
ocr.crop_policy: whole plus center with floor(8% of each original dimension) removed per edge
ocr.input_policy: EasyOCR original view uses native file path; all other views and RapidOCR use BGR arrays

sqlite.keyword_policy: deduplicated words and known 2/3-word joins within one OCR view; max 64 characters per word
sqlite.score_policy: exact > folded > fuzzy > maker > FTS; bounded multi-keyword support

metadata.pool_policy: strong SQL first; SQL top5 + appearance top5; fill SQL then appearance to10
metadata.shape_policy: preserve exact/folded aliases; otherwise k60 RRF of retrieval and known shape rank

config.timing: measured fresh cumulative OCR/SQLite/appearance/shape stages; one untimed query warmup; model loading excluded
